summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that runs automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers for fs/https/zlib imports and indirection wrapper objects) and downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and spawns it via `execFileSync` to run a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `@bun-cjs` bundle with obfuscator.io-style array-rotation string decoding (`WV8StW` dispatcher over a shuffled constant array) that Node cannot parse, so its behavior is opaque to installers and static review. The advertised purpose is a Webpack plugin restricting imports; there is no build-time need for an alternate JS runtime or an opaque bundled payload executed on the installer's host. The alternate-runtime bring-your-own-interpreter pattern is used to evade Node-only scanners while giving arbitrary code execution on every install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
